question: _____ is a generic term, which refers to all the legal and regulatory aspects of Internet and the World Wide Web.
solution:
The correct answer is **Cyber law**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Cyber law** refers to the legal and regulatory aspects of the Internet and the World Wide Web.
 
• It covers a broad range of legal issues related to the use of the Internet, such as intellectual property rights, privacy, cybercrimes, and electronic commerce.
